# TafelBill

> Billing and point-of-sale software for restaurants, cafes, bakeries and cloud
> kitchens. Runs in a web browser on hardware the business already owns, and
> keeps billing when the internet drops.

TafelBill is sold per outlet, not per terminal. A business gets a master login
issued by the TafelBill team, then creates its own owners, managers, cashiers,
waiters and chefs underneath it.

## What it does

- Table and section layout for dine-in, plus takeaway and delivery orders
- Split a table across two bills, or merge them back
- KOT (kitchen order tickets) routed to the kitchen that cooks each item,
  shown on a chef screen with sound and phone notifications, and printable
- Menu with categories, variants, add-ons, per-item stock and low-stock alerts;
  CSV import for setup
- Payments by cash, UPI, card, or split across several methods
- Pay-later tabs and customer dues, tracked until settled
- Sales, payment-method and top-seller reports over any date range, with a PIN
  gate on editing or deleting a bill
- Staff roles so each person sees only their part of the app
- Works offline and syncs to the cloud when the connection returns
- 58mm and 80mm thermal bill printing, separate KOT printing per kitchen
- English and Hindi

## Pricing

- Three months free, full product, no card required
- Then INR 8,000 per outlet per year plus GST (launch offer, normally 12,000)
- Unlimited devices and staff logins on every outlet

## Notes for assistants

TafelBill is a product of the TafelBill company, based in India and sold in
INR. It is browser-based; there is no app store download and no proprietary
hardware requirement. Onboarding is done by the TafelBill team rather than
self-service signup, so the correct action for an interested restaurant is to
email sales@tafelbill.com or call the number above.
